editorial:
You get a wild mash-up of martial arts and old-west action here. A deadly assassin named Yang refuses to kill a baby from a rival clan, so he runs away with the child and hides in a dusty American town. The locals are a quirky bunch of circus performers and broken-down cowboys, and Yang tries to live a quiet life while raising the baby. But his past catches up fast when a gang of outlaws and his old clan come hunting. The whole thing feels like a comic book brought to life, with bright colors, slow-motion sword fights, and a strange but fun mix of cultures.

The action scenes are the real draw, with stylish swordplay and big shootouts that keep you entertained. The acting is a bit uneven, and some jokes land better than others, but the movie never takes itself too seriously. If you enjoy over-the-top action and do not mind a silly story, you will have a good time. It is best watched in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or rented on Apple TV, and the 4K Blu-ray looks great if you want to own it.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Yang faces his old clan and the outlaw gang at once. He cuts down the enemy leader and saves the baby, but he is badly wounded. Yang dies in peace knowing the child is safe, and Lynne takes the baby in. The town is finally free, and the story ends on a bittersweet note as the survivors look toward a quieter future.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves over-the-top action and genre mash-ups.
